reclaimed-wood-dining-furniture.title: Reclaimed Wood Dining Furniture
reclaimed-wood-dining-furniture.label: Reclaimed Wood
reclaimed-wood-dining-furniture.description:
You’re Getting A One-of-a-Kind 

There is a certain fascinating aura of mystique, mystery and awe associated with barnwood. Especially, when you consider the path a single barnwood board may have traveled. Most of the reclaimed wood furniture is solid hardwood oak. Which, of course, means it started as an acorn falling from a tree.

All solid wood furniture has its own one-of-a-kind natural quality about it—because no piece has the exact same woodgrain or color characteristics. However, barnwood is in a unique category since it has already served one life in a barn structure somewhere in the midwestern United States before it graces your personal living space in the form of barnwood furniture.

Today, with less farming and as these buildings continue to age some are restored close to their original state and others are felled or disassembled piece by piece, so that as much as possible, the precious natural resource – the wood, can be reclaimed. The barnwood process is an excellent green way to preserve the old and vintage and give the precious natural resource – wood – a second life.

buckingham-amish-office-collection.title: Buckingham Amish Office Collection
paras: If you're looking for timeless beauty that defies trends, look to the clean lines and lustrous finishes of the Buckingham Series. The fluted corner posts are classic design elements used by ancient Greek artisans, who may have been inspired by the look of natural tree trunks.
Pictured in Cherry Wood with O.C.S. Washington stain

homestead-amish-office-collection.title: Homestead Amish Office Collection
paras: Pure, simple elegance finds its expression in the Homestead Series. Unadorned corners, straight lines, and inset panels all serve to showcase the rich cherry wood with its naturally contrasting grain. Cherry has always been prized for strength and beauty. Both are obvious in this stunning collection.
The Amish Homestead Executive Set offers a stunning executive desk, with a credenza and filing cabinet that keep your busy office fully functional and breathtakingly beautiful at the same time.
Executive Desk, Credenza, and File Cabinet Pictured in Cherry Wood with OCS Boston Stain

jefferson-amish-office-collection.title: Jefferson Amish Office Collection
paras: Classically-inspired corner columns, similar to the ones prominent at Monticello, make this series aptly named. We hope our third president would be pleased with the symmetry and attention to detail, along with the two-tone finish reminiscent of the famous mansion he designed.
Pictured in Cherry Wood with FC 9090 Chocolate Spice Stain and Stone Finish Columns

lexington-amish-office-collection.title: Lexington Amish Office Collection
paras: Every Amish-made furniture style has unique design touches that raise it far above ordinary furniture. In the Lexington Series they are found in the vertical braided columns at each corner post, repeated on a much smaller scale in the base molding.
Pictured in Cherry Wood with OCS Acres stain

liberty-executive-amish-office-collectio.title: Liberty Executive Amish Office Collection
paras: This classic version of colonial style furniture recalls the time of our country's founding, when liberty was codified into law more extensively than ever before. Unadorned, without superfluous decoration, the Liberty Series reflects the simple determination to create a nation in which freedom would be the enduring theme.
Pictured in Cherry Wood with O.C.S. Rich Cherry stain

lincoln-amish-office-collection.title: Lincoln Amish Office Collection
paras: This collection bearing the name of our sixteenth president rests on sturdy feet, rises with authority using grooved columns, then tops off with highly ornamented crown molding. It combines an air of dignity with the grace and elegance so prevalent in the mid-19th century.
Pictured in Brown Maple Wood with Dutch Tavern stain

manhattan-executive-amish-office-collect.title: Manhattan Executive Amish Office Collection
paras: Is it a stretch to be reminded of skyscrapers in the corner posts of this furniture, leading to this collection's name? Perhaps. But there's no denying that this sturdy and timeless style would feel right at home in the City That Never Sleeps. Or wherever the height of beauty is desired.

The Amish-made Manhattan Executive Office is the very finest in luxurious office furniture. We've brought together a set of office necessities that will make your office shine and your workday productive.
Pictured in Brown Maple Wood with FC 11047 Ebony and Chocolate Tavern Stain & Optional Re-Sawn Top and Drawer Fronts

montereau-amish-office-collection.title: Montereau Amish Office Collection
